description: Gemini API keys issued via Google AI Studio (`aistudio.google.com`). Used for generative-language endpoints under `generativelanguage.googleapis.com`. Vertex-AI customers authenticate via service-account JSON instead — that lives under a separate path family (`team/gcp/...`).

variants.description: Project-scoped key from Google AI Studio. Authenticates `generativelanguage.googleapis.com` chat / embed / file endpoints via the `?key=…` query param or `x-goog-api-key` header. Does NOT cover Vertex AI — that's a separate auth path through service-account credentials.

steps: Sign in with the Google account that owns the GCP project
Pick the GCP project the key bills to (or Create new project)
Copy the value — shown once on this page; you can revoke later from the same page
retrieval.notes: Gemini API keys are project-scoped: revoking one does not affect other keys in the same project. Quotas and billing follow the linked GCP project. For server workloads, prefer Vertex AI service-account credentials over a Studio key — Studio keys are intended for prototypes and personal accounts.
